keyword.zh: 柴油40和柴油50混凝土泵的区别

title.zh: 柴油40和柴油50混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: Diesel 40 prints a 4108 engine at 66 kW. Diesel 50 prints a 6105 engine at 99 kW, with 30 m³/h and 30 MPa.
description.zh: 柴油40印 4108 发动机 66 kW。柴油50印 6105 发动机 99 kW，产量 30 m³/h，压力 30 MPa。

h1.zh: 柴油40和柴油50混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Diesel 40 and Diesel 50 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps in Xingtai. Diesel 40 prints 4108 / 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 25 MPa, distance 120 m / 360 m and Kawasaki 112. Diesel 50 prints 6105 / 99 kW, 30 m³/h, 30 MPa, distance 150 m / 450 m and Kawasaki 140. Both print a 0.4 m³ hopper. Neither specification table prints an aggregate-size row.
directAnswer.zh: 柴油40和柴油50是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。柴油40印 4108 / 66 kW、26 m³/h、25 MPa、距离 120 m / 360 m、川崎112。柴油50印 6105 / 99 kW、30 m³/h、30 MPa、距离 150 m / 450 m、川崎140。料斗两边都是 0.4 m³。两份规格表都没有骨料粒径行。

heading.en: Where Diesel 40 and Diesel 50 print different values
heading.zh: 柴油40和柴油50哪些数值不同

body.en: Diesel engine power: Diesel 40 prints 4108 / 66 kW; Diesel 50 prints 6105 / 99 kW. Theoretical output: Diesel 40 prints 26 m³/h; Diesel 50 prints 30 m³/h. Max. outlet pressure: Diesel 40 prints 25 MPa; Diesel 50 prints 30 MPa. Pumping distance (H / V): Diesel 40 prints 120 m / 360 m; Diesel 50 prints 150 m / 450 m. Hydraulic pump: Diesel 40 prints Kawasaki 112; Diesel 50 prints Kawasaki 140. Dimensions: Diesel 40 prints 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm; Diesel 50 prints 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm. The same printed value on a shared label: Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³ on both pages. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 柴油机功率：柴油40印 4108 / 66 kW；柴油50印 6105 / 99 kW。理论输送量：柴油40印 26 m³/h；柴油50印 30 m³/h。最大出口压力：柴油40印 25 MPa；柴油50印 30 MPa。输送距离（水平/垂直）：柴油40印 120 m / 360 m；柴油50印 150 m / 450 m。液压泵：柴油40印 Kawasaki 112；柴油50印 Kawasaki 140。外形尺寸：柴油40印 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm；柴油50印 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm。同一标题下数值相同的有：料斗容积两边都是 0.4 m³。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Both pages use the same set of labels. Where the values differ, keep the value on the page you opened. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 两页标题集合相同。数值不同时，以你打开的那一页为准。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: Do not invent an aggregate size for either page from a neighbouring diesel row. Open /en/products/diesel-40-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 40 and /en/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 50. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 不要用相邻柴油泵的骨料行，给这两页编一个粒径。看柴油40请打开 /zh/products/diesel-40-concrete-pump/，看柴油50请打开 /zh/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Diesel 40 print the same diesel engine power as Diesel 50?
question.zh: 柴油40和柴油50的柴油机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 40 prints 4108 / 66 kW. Diesel 50 prints 6105 / 99 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油40印 4108 / 66 kW。柴油50印 6105 / 99 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Diesel 40 print the same theoretical output as Diesel 50?
question.zh: 柴油40和柴油50的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 40 prints 26 m³/h. Diesel 50 prints 30 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油40印 26 m³/h。柴油50印 30 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Diesel 40 print the same max. outlet pressure as Diesel 50?
question.zh: 柴油40和柴油50的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 40 prints 25 MPa. Diesel 50 prints 30 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油40印 25 MPa。柴油50印 30 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Can I treat Diesel 40 and Diesel 50 as one concrete pump?
question.zh: 可以把柴油40和柴油50当成同一台混凝土泵吗？

answer.en: No. They are separate pages from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Match power, output, pressure and distance on the page you intend to order.
answer.zh: 不能。它们是河北品锦机械在邢台的两个页面。要按下单的那一页核对功率、产量、压力和距离。
